name: ai-goofish-monitor
description: 基于 Playwright 和AI实现的闲鱼多任务实时/定时监控与智能分析系统，配备了功能完善的后台管理UI。帮助用户从闲鱼海量商品中，找到心仪产品。
one_liner: A robot that watches China's biggest secondhand marketplace around the clock and instantly alerts you when an item you want shows up underpriced.
buyer: A reseller or sourcing agent who flips used electronics, watches, or collectibles and needs to beat other buyers to underpriced listings the moment they appear.
business_use_cases: A reseller runs the monitor 24/7 on cameras, sneakers, or watches, buying underpriced finds within seconds and reselling them at a markup.
A sourcing agency offers overseas collectors a 'we snipe it for you' concierge service, using the monitor to catch rare items before other buyers notice.
A small retailer tracks competitors' listings and pricing patterns on the marketplace to adjust its own prices in near real time.

money_ideas.idea: Charge clients a flat finder's fee or commission per successful item sourced through the monitor.
Sell a managed 'concierge sourcing' subscription that watches a client's wish list continuously.

steal_this: Wire the notification channel to Telegram, pick one collectible niche (e.g. film cameras), and launch a 'we'll ping you the second one drops below market price' bot this weekend, charging a small monthly fee per watched category.
